items.title: Bill Allred interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 24, 2017
items.q: And Bette Midler and David Hyde Pierce — it’s going to be a good show.

ctx.x: What’s your opinion on going to school for jazz?

Well I mean I wish I had. Maybe not for jazz. I wish I would have gone to school for composition. Because I have so many great ideas. I’ve dictated so many great ideas, as far as charts. And I say great ideas, not bragging. But I really feel that if I would have spent the time in Theory and stuff like that in school instead of down at some black club in Rock Island trying to learn how to play bebop lines and — but it all goes in your bag of tricks. But I just could have done better as far as my personal — but at…
Well that’s some great advice, and you guys got to record together a couple of times?
